User Feedback Integration: Gather feedback from plant operators, supervisors, and site super-users to continuously improve standard work documentation and data structures. Testing & Validation: Support system testing, data validation, and troubleshooting for new Solumina releases, data table updates, or template modifications. Experience delivering presentations using data visualization tools to communicate production metrics or project updates to cross-functional teams or leadership. fresh_leads.qualification_text: Summer Research Program Intern 2027, Electric Grid Communications Security, Energy Systems (Gr 47) (Lexington, MA, US) Lexington, MA, US The Energy Systems Group at MIT Lincoln Laboratory develops technology solutions that enhance the resilience and efficiency of both civilian and defense energy systems. This includes developing advanced architectures and system designs to improve the resilience of power grids, developing new control techniques for microgrids and distributed energy resources, and developing hardware and real-time simulation testbeds. The Energy Systems Group seeks a summer intern to work within a multi-disciplinary team to help strengthen the cybersecurity of the electric grid. The candidate hired for this position will characterize technology solutions that enable electric utilities to secure Operational Technology (OT) networks and components. Securing these fundamental elements of the electric grid can help prevent a network intrusion from escalating into a consequential cyber-attack. The candidate will help design, implement and conduct tests within MIT Lincoln Laboratory's Hardware-In-the-Loop (HIL) test facility. Tasks may include Integrating zero trust (ZT) vendor solutions into the testbed Developing test harness software Assessing effectiveness of the solutions to mitigate attacks The data and analysis produced by the candidate will be integrated into guidelines and recommendations made by MIT Lincoln Laboratory to its government sponsors. fresh_leads.qualification_text: Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree (BS) in Engineering, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Life Science or other related technical discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Working knowledge of FDA, cGMP, Quality System Regulations (QSR), and ISO quality system requirements. Knowledge of quality engineering principles, investigations, root cause analysis, and process improvement methodologies. Strong technical writing, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
